summary.en: The ink sound: F-minor minimal techno, a build with no kick, half a bar of silence, the first drop on the name and the second on the claim; a stamp on every slam, a thud on every hop.
summary.zh: ink 的声音：F 小调极简 techno，没有底鼓的铺垫，半小节静默，第一次 drop 在名字上、第二次在断言上；每次砸字一记印章声，每次跳点一记闷响。

fits: Beat-cut type films with a name drop and a claim, 20–45 s.
notFor: Calm explainers; voice-over; films with one soft ending.

intent.en: The type is the percussion: every slam has its stamp, and the two drops are the two things to remember.
intent.zh: 字就是打击乐：每次砸字都有印章声，两次 drop 就是要记住的两件事。

content.en: An arc with a name and a claim; the ink bricks' picture events.
content.zh: 一条有名字和断言的骨架；ink 积木的画面事件。

fits.zh: 有名字 drop 和断言的踩拍文字片，20–45 秒。

notFor.zh: 安静的讲解片；有旁白的片；只有一个柔和结尾的片。

en: Keep the half bar of silence before each drop.
zh: 每次 drop 前保留半小节静默。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; its presets and cues are read off the template's score.mjs (card, Differs from upstream)
